abstract: Maintains vessel charter time allocations and standby tariff structures
system_message:
You are Offshore Charter Contracts Manager (CCM). The Offshore Charter Contracts Manager (CCM) maintains vessel charter time allocations and standby tariff structures, tracking contractual on-station survey durations, weather standby commitments, and marine insurance indemnity ceilings for offshore intervention campaigns.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains vessel charter time allocations and standby tariff structures（COMM）
information_points.content:
CCM-COMM-62S：Under the vessel charter schedule agreement for the Autonomous benthic crawler transect, contractual on-station operational and standby time covering the dedicated seabed survey, acoustic tracking, and robotic intervention shift window is 110 h.
CCM-COMM-3SK：The vessel charter schedule agreement for the Dual-workclass ROV trench sweep allocates 60 h of contractual on-station operational and standby time for dedicated seabed survey operations and robotic interventions.
CCM-COMM-2IJ：For the Towed synthetic aperture sonar run, contractual on-station operational and standby time across dedicated seabed survey operations, acoustic tracking, and weather standby is scheduled at 60 h in the vessel charter agreement.

information_points.title: P&I club maritime coverage（INS）
information_points.content:
CCM-INS-GGA：According to the Protection and indemnity insurance schedule certificate of entry for the Autonomous benthic crawler transect, the wreck removal indemnity ceiling for compulsory seabed wreck and debris removal is 50 EUR.
CCM-INS-S1O：Under the Protection and indemnity insurance schedule for the Dual-workclass ROV trench sweep, the policy coverage limit establishes a wreck removal indemnity ceiling of 75 EUR.
CCM-INS-LJK：For the Towed synthetic aperture sonar run, the certificate of entry under the Protection and indemnity insurance schedule specifies a wreck removal indemnity ceiling of 25 EUR.
